name: Civic Reading Room · Praya detail pass
description: A neighbourhood library pavilion: double-height reading hall, glazed frontage, rooflights and a sheltered civic forecourt. September 9 successor: recessed glazing, projecting sills, connected thin blocks, framed signage and supported finishing details; original layout and identity retained.
